target.visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
target.left_evidence: The dashed horizontal edge from the interior rear lower vertex toward the right lower vertex.
target.right_evidence: The nearly vertical black dashed line beside the two branches of the curve.
target.left_meaning: It represents a hidden rear edge of the rectangular prism.
target.right_meaning: It is the vertical asymptote used as a reference for the plotted function.
target.reason: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right broken vertical reference is an asymptote beside a function curve, with no solid to supply an occluded edge. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
